intent: A modal dialog on Radix Dialog — focus trap, Escape, aria-modal, portal — composed from ModalHeader / ModalBody / ModalFooter, with width presets and an optional backdrop.
guidance: Compose from ModalHeader / ModalBody / ModalFooter: the header and footer pin while the body scrolls inside max-h 90vh. Pick a width preset (compact 240 / dialog 320 / standard 480) or pass a vh value for tall/medium. Drop the scrim with backdrop=false for a floating inspector dialog that must not block the canvas. Use stacked with ModalCard when a share flow needs separate floating cards instead of one tall card. In-modal menus and tooltips portal to document.body, so the card's overflow-hidden never clips them. Always supply a title so RadixDialog.Title can name the dialog for assistive tech.

anatomy.description: Optional full-screen scrim (backdrop=true) at rgba(0,0,0,0.4); blocks background interaction. Omitted for floating inspector dialogs (backdrop=false).
Centered content card: bg/default, radius/lg, elevation/500, overflow-hidden, max-h 90vh, flex column. Goes transparent when stacked so each ModalCard paints its own surface.
40px top row with a bottom border: title / tabs / navigation slot, optional actions, and the close X. Title binds to RadixDialog.Title for a11y.
Scrollable content area (flex-1); a tall dialog scrolls via the DS ScrollArea overlay thumb while header and footer stay pinned. Optional 16px padding.
48px bottom row with a top border; actions right-aligned by default (start / center / end / between).
24px X button in the header, aria-label="Close", wired to RadixDialog.Close.

use_when: A blocking task that owns focus (share, settings, confirm).
A floating inspector dialog beside the canvas (backdrop=false).
dont_use_when: A transient, non-blocking message — use Notification.
A contextual action list — use Menu.

slots.children: ModalHeader / ModalBody / ModalFooter, or a column of ModalCard when stacked.

tokens.note: Backdrop is a hardcoded rgba(0,0,0,0.4) (mode-invariant modal-backdrop), not a c-* token. Dimensions are hardcoded pixels: header 40px, footer 48px, card max-h 90vh, X 24px, nav labels 11px/font-450, MODAL_STACK_GAP 8px.

a11y.role: dialog (Radix Dialog.Content: role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, Escape, portal). Supplied by Radix, not literally in source.
a11y.title: RadixDialog.Title in ModalHeader labels the dialog; falls back to an sr-only title for the tabs variant or when none is passed.

code.import: import { Modal, ModalHeader, ModalBody, ModalFooter } from '@composa/ui'
code.example:
<Modal open={open} onClose={close} width="standard">
  <ModalHeader title="Share" onClose={close} />
  <ModalBody padding>…</ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter>…</ModalFooter>
</Modal>
